text.description_html:
Acorn AINBP, 15-5/8" Smooth Iron Bean Tip Heavy Strap Hinge

The Acorn made 15-5/8" Bean Tip Strap Hinge gives an old world charm to any woodworking project, gate, shutter, entry door, or garage door. The smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. When using 3 hinges, the 15-5/8" Bean Tip Heavy Strap Hinge is suitable to hold doors up to 175 pounds.

Also Available Matching: 19-5/8" Bean Tip Smooth Iron Heavy Strap Hinge

Features of the Smooth Iron Bean Strap Hinges:

  • Removable pin and reversible pads for full or half surface application. Includes hardware.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

    • Specifications of the 15-5/8" Smooth Iron Bean Tip Heavy Strap Hinge:

    • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
    • Using 3 hinges 15" strap hinges are suitable for doors 1-3/8" thick by 32" wide up to 175 lbs.
    • Length: 15-5/8"
    • Strap Width at hinge: 1-9/16"
    • Gauge: .155
    • Pad Width: 2"
    • Pad Length: 4"

    For heavy duty hinges that can be used on doors up to 600 lbs Click Here.

    Sold Individually
